clips.title: The story
paras: Blackfathom Deeps lies flooded beneath the Zoram Strand on Ashenvale's northwestern coast. Its halls once honored Elune, but naga, satyr, and the Twilight's Hammer now hold the ruins.

Beneath Ashenvale's northwestern cliffs, flooded halls mark the remains of an ancient temple. Before the Great Sundering shattered Kalimdor ten thousand years ago, the temple honored Elune and held its own moonwell. When the Well of Eternity collapsed, the shrine sank beneath the waves and was presumed lost forever. Over millennia, shorelines receded and the ground shifted below, leaving the temple partly flooded beneath the cliffs.
